Businesses remit tax on value added; final prices, wages, and returns transmit the burden
Consumers broadly; essentials exclusions narrow direct exposure
Consumption taxes can absorb a larger income share for households that consume most current income
Refundable per-person credit or cash payment; preserve a broad base where possible rather than proliferating opaque exclusions

agi_surtax
Individual filers pay on AGI above the specified threshold
Broad alternative reaches moderate-income filers; higher-threshold alternative concentrates on higher-income filers
Threshold choice changes both revenue and vertical equity; filing-unit and family-size effects matter
Index thresholds; test household-size adjustment and interaction with existing credits
blocked_requires_tax_unit_microsimulation
employment_health_tax_subsidy
Income and payroll tax exclusion is limited; employers and workers adjust compensation and plan design
Workers and families with higher-premium employer plans, including some high-cost markets and older workforces
Premium level is an imperfect proxy for plan generosity and can reflect geography or health risk
Risk- and geography-adjusted cap, long phase-in, and protection for collectively bargained or high-risk plans
blocked_requires_employer_household_model
emissions_tax
Upstream emitters or fuel suppliers remit tax; energy and goods prices transmit it
Energy users, workers, owners, and regions with carbon-intensive production
Energy burden and employment transition can be geographically concentrated
Return some revenue per capita; targeted transition and energy-affordability support without erasing the price signal
blocked_requires_energy_household_regional_model
defense_annual_budget
Federal appropriations and resulting outlays decline
Military personnel, contractors, communities, suppliers, and capabilities selected in implementation
Across-the-board reductions can ignore readiness, security, workforce, and regional concentration
Capability-led portfolio review, multiyear transition, workforce conversion, and explicit readiness floors
blocked_unspecified_program_mix
medicare_advantage_benchmarks
Federal payments to Medicare Advantage plans decline
Plans, providers, taxpayers, and enrollees through premiums, supplemental benefits, networks, or market exits
Average savings can conceal county, plan, access, and medically vulnerable enrollee effects
Phase-in, risk adjustment, access and quality floors, county monitoring, and enrollee transition protections
blocked_requires_plan_county_enrollee_model
foreign_corporate_income
U.S. corporations with foreign income face higher federal tax
Shareholders, workers, consumers, and affected multinational activity through uncertain incidence channels
Legal payer is not the same as economic bearer; investment and profit-location responses matter
Coordinate anti-avoidance rules and test shareholder, wage, price, investment, and international responses

financial_transactions_tax
Financial intermediaries or traders remit tax on covered transactions
Investors, retirement savers, intermediaries, issuers, and high-turnover strategies
Burden and market-quality effects depend on pass-through, avoidance, volume, spreads, and asset coverage
Low rate, broad coordinated base, retirement-account incidence test, and liquidity/avoidance monitoring
blocked_requires_market_and_household_incidence_model
package_tests: Report burden by income, wealth, age, family type, race and ethnicity where data support it, geography, industry, and health status where relevant.
Separate statutory remittance from economic incidence.
Show gross burden, offsets or rebates, net burden, service effects, and transition effects.
Test cumulative interactions across all package components rather than adding isolated incidence tables.
Publish uncertainty and identify groups not represented adequately in the underlying data.
headline: A fiscally large package is not distributionally neutral: the design question is not only how much each lever raises or saves, but who ultimately bears it and what protections preserve access and basic living standards.
